mapper.sql: VERIFICATION_ID AS verificationId, PURPOSE_CODE AS purposeCode, CHANNEL_CODE AS channelCode, TARGET_HMAC AS targetHmac, USER_ID AS userId, CODE_HASH AS codeHash, ATTEMPT_COUNT AS attemptCount, EXPIRES_AT AS expiresAt, VERIFIED_AT AS verifiedAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VERIFICATION_CODE (PURPOSE_CODE, CHANNEL_CODE, TARGET_HMAC, USER_ID, CODE_HASH, ATTEMPT_COUNT, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{purposeCode}, #{channelCode}, #{targetHmac}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{codeHash}, 0, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE VERIFICATION_CODE SET ATTEMPT_COUNT = ATTEMPT_COUNT + 1 WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId}

UPDATE VERIFICATION_CODE SET VERIFIED_AT = #{now}, EXPIRES_AT = #{tokenExpiresAt}, USER_ID = COALESCE(#{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, USER_ID) WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId} AND VERIFIED_AT IS NULL
